About the Position

The RAINZ CDT prepares you to become part of the next generation of multi-disciplinary robotic systems engineers for Net Zero applications.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: RAINZ CDT - Robotics and AI for Net Zero
HostUniversity of Manchester
LocationManchester, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
Stipend£21,805 per year (tax-free, UKRI rate)
Application DeadlineRolling
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Robotics and AI for Net Zero (RAINZ)
  • Host Institution: The University of Manchester (in partnership with Glasgow and Oxford)
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 4 years
  • Start Date: September 2026
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: £21,805 (2026/27 UKRI minimum) per year (tax-free, UKRI rate)
  • Eligibility: Home students (UK)
  • Contact: rainz@manchester.ac.uk

Programme Description

The RAINZ CDT will prepare you to become part of the next generation of multi-disciplinary robotic systems engineers. When you first join RAINZ CDT, you will undertake one year of taught studies at The University of Manchester, before undertaking your PhD at your host institute (Manchester, Glasgow, or Oxford). The CDT unites leading researchers from The University of Manchester, Glasgow and Oxford.

Contact

  • Email: rainz@manchester.ac.uk

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.rainz-cdt.ac.uk/

Source: rainz-cdt.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Rolling - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Manchester

The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across engineering, science, medicine, business and the humanities. Its research community connects academic discovery with challenges in health, sustainability, technology and society through collaboration.

Official website: https://www.manchester.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: Rolling. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
